items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Freddie Coleman and I were working as a duo at the, um, Flamingo.

ctx.x: I was set there as an entertainment director. All of this other stuff. Uh huh. This is up in the air. And that's one of the big acts that, um, President Roosevelt did for that ordinance camp. Nobody was supposed to be assigned there. It's a school. Hardin' a school. Even my, uh, CO wasn't assigned, but he never did get shipped. And I was assigned there because this was, uh, the, the, uh, the beginning of the integration then. Uh huh. Trying to integrate the armed forces. And I was one of the GOATs and I didn't…
I met you there. We were in music school together. Yeah.
